instruction.text: Write the word that you hear.
Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: I love riding on the top of the bus.
atoms.b: I love riding on the top of the ((bus)).

atoms.a: The green car has four doors, but you can only see two.
atoms.b: The green ((car)) has four doors, but you can only see two.

atoms.a: The sun makes the air feel warm.
atoms.b: The ((sun)) makes the air feel warm.

atoms.a: The pirates have to be home by the end of the day.
atoms.b: The pirates have to be home by the end of the ((day)).
